t: This is the Matilda Fountain, a Grade II listed statue and drinking fountain opposite 15 Gloucester Gate on the edge of Regent's Park. It was built in about 1878. The sculptor was Joseph Durham, an English sculptor. It takes its name from Matilda Kent, who presented it to the Metropolitan Drinking Fountain and Cattle Trough Association. The material I have gives little more about her, so I won't guess.
